name: Secret Bloom
description:
The Vibe: Alluring, mysterious, and effortlessly elegant.

The Scent Journey: A gorgeous blend of sweet vanilla, creamy cacao, and soft almond, beautifully intertwined with radiant white florals and warm spices. Wrapped in a rich embrace of golden amber and smooth woody notes, it finishes with a delicate, powdery touch that feels highly sophisticated.

Best For: An enchanting evening scent that leaves a lingering impression of luxury.
